Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc
Adapts any JDBC data source to the Diwan Database driver interface.

JdbcDriver implements Driver over a JdbcConnectionProvider, and DataSourceConnectionProvider is the provider for a plain DataSource. This is the only package that uses java.sql or javax.sql; values crossing out of it follow the value contract of the driver package, so no JDBC type reaches the caller.
